final_summary:
Board、Priorities、Dump 三页都已改成 Projects 页的 page structure。PR [#90](https://github.com/Marsuu1994/mars-workbench/pull/90) 已开，ready for review。head（`d6b5ce3`）上的 CI 全绿，可合并，无冲突。

分支 `claude/page-structure-b3` 上一共 4 个 commit：每页一个，文档一个。功能行为没有变化。

## 每页的改动
- **Board**：`KanbanBoard` 改名 `BoardPage`，吸收 `BoardScreen` 的两层布局，并自己渲染 header 和 dashboard；`BoardScreen` 已删。新增 `BoardPageContext`（`pullToTodo`），`MobileBacklogCard` 去掉了 `onPull`。console 的两个 board tab 改渲染 `BoardPage`，手机 backlog sheet 和 gallery 的 card specimen 包在 `inertBoardPageContext` 里。
- **Priorities**：`PriorityMatrixPage` 改名 `PrioritiesPage`，吸收 `PrioritiesScreen`；`PrioritiesScreen` 已删。
  - route 里没有 plan 时的周回退抽成 adapter `toPrioritiesPageProps`，分组和 tracked 判断改为 `groupTasksByQuadrant`、`isTrackedTask`，三个都放在 `utils/oneOffUtils.ts`，有 unit test。
  - 新增 `PrioritiesPageContext`。prop 数：`QuadrantCell` 9→2、`MatrixTaskCard` 9→2、`MoveToPopover` 4→1、`MoveToRows` 5→2、`MobileMoveToSheet` 6→2、`MobileMoveToPanel` 5→1，和 spike 的目标一致。
  - console 的 7 个 tab 渲染 `PrioritiesPage`，fixture 走同一个 adapter；手机 Move-to panel 和 gallery 的卡片包在 `inertPrioritiesPageContext` 里。
- **Dump**：`DumpScreen` 改名 `DumpPage`，新增 `DumpPageContext`（`capture`、`captureError`、`loadMore`）。`DumpComposer` 的 prop 2→0，`DumpFeed` 4→3。route 的整形抽成 adapter `toDumpPageProps`，有 unit test；没有新增 action 或 service。
- **文档**：更新了 `baseline.md`、AGENTS.md、Design Console README、tracker 和 README Update Log；spike 移到了 `design/spike/archived/`，链接已修。

## 跑过的检查
- `format`、`lint`、`typecheck`、`knip`、`check:themes` 全部通过。
- `npm test`（UTC 和 Los Angeles 两个时区）436 条通过，另有 2 条预期失败的 `it.fails`。
- e2e 26 条全过。
- 真实页面点击检查全部通过，每个操作 reload 后都确认已保存，没有 console error：
  - Board：拖到 Done、手机 pull。
  - Priorities：拖象限、track、Done、Done 后 Undo、桌面 add、手机 sheet track、手机 picker add。
  - Dump：capture、load more。
- Board 的 `ui-verifier` 检查：5 个 tab 在桌面和手机宽度下的布局检查都通过。
  - 它标了一个 FAIL：只给桌面用的「backlog open」tab 在 390px 下 play step 找到两个同名的「Open backlog」按钮。这个 play step 和那两个按钮的 title 本 PR 都没碰，我判断是原有问题，没修；我没有在 main 上复现确认过。

## Judgment calls（PR
notes: Scope: 474 assistant/user events on 7 pages (100 raw events per page; the kinds filter leaves 11-90 per page), 228 main-session (146 assistant, 82 user) and 246 from the four subagents, interleaved with parent_tool_use_id/agent_id/task_description: Board 49 events (16 requests), Priorities 101 (33), Dump 68 (22), ui-verifier 28 (10). `usage.all_messages` and `process` sum everything; `usage.main_session_only` and `process_main_session` are the main session alone (74 of 155 requests, 72 of 165 tool calls). Do not add agent usage on top of `all_messages`; add it to `main_session_only` instead.

output_tokens on assistant events are unusable: every event of a message carries the same message_start placeholder (2,929 'output tokens' over 155 messages; the 2,964-char final summary shows 14) and stop_reason is null on all 299 events. Input-side counts are consistent. True output comes from the 6 result events: the main session wrote 45,431 output tokens (9,417 thinking) over its six turns (10,816 / 512 / 283 / 31,094 / 303 / 2,423); the session-wide modelUsage ends at 111,393 output (18,684 thinking), so the four subagents produced about 65,962 by subtraction. Cost at list price: $9.08 (modelUsage costUSD), context window 1M, model claude-opus-5-5 on all 299 events and the only model in modelUsage; no fallback notice seen (system-kind events were not read).

The result events' two usage blocks mean different things: `usage` is the main session's own usage for that turn and matches the transcript's main-only assistant events exactly (turn 0: cache_read 1,794,478 both ways; turn 1 delta 403,308 both ways); `modelUsage` is cumulative over the whole session including subagents (at turn 0 it lags the transcript because the three page agents were mid-flight). The final modelUsage exceeds the transcript's all-event sum by 2,069 input / 904 cache_creation / 789,693 cache_read tokens (~4%), and num_turns sums to 79 API requests against 74 main message ids in the transcript, so a handful of main-session requests left no assistant event (interrupted or retried calls, most likely). first_request_input_tokens was 81,524; the main context peaked at 235,551.

The `<usage>` subagent_tokens figures (Board 91,872; Priorities 152,716; Dump 102,402; ui-verifier 47,660) are not cumulative totals: each sits 1.6-2.9k above that agent's largest single request (90,199 / 149,776 / 100,822 / 45,928 input+cache_creation+cache_read), i.e. roughly the final hand-back request's context plus its output. Cumulative input-side usage from the transcript is 1.29M / 3.93M / 1.90M / 0.31M tokens. The blocks' tool_uses (19 / 36 / 27 / 11) and durations (141 s / 349 s / 189 s / 115 s, measured from launch, not from the Agent call) match the transcript exactly.

Agent calls were asynchronous: each Agent tool_result is an 'Async agent launched successfully' acknowledgement (Board 30 s after its call, the other two about 1 s), and all three page agents' first events come after the third launch at 05:32:08.8. Completions arrived as synthetic user turns ('Another Claude session sent a message: <agent-message from=...>' holding the hand-back report) followed 1-2 s later by a <task-notification> turn (isReplay=true, origin session-task) carrying the <usage> block. Each page-agent hand-back started a new main-session turn (result events 1-3 have origin = subagent hand-back; turns 1 and 2 lasted 12 s and 9 s and did one cherry-pick each). The ui-verifier's report (SubagentHandback at 05:43:02) was delivered only at 05:45:41, when the main session's 3.5-minute click-through Bash call (05:42:08-05:45:41) returned, and joined the running turn 3 (05:38:03 -> 06:05:39, 27.7 min, 46 requests) instead of starting one.

Three general-purpose agents ran with isolation: worktree on their own branches (claude/page-structure-b3-board / -priorities / -dump), each committing once (18ea5b6, f419c91, d2c3dee) and not pushing; the main session cherry-picked them onto claude/page-structure-b3 one hand-back at a time (05:34:33 Board, 05:35:19 Dump, 05:38:04 Priorities). The Priorities cherry-pick conflicted in the two console files both agents had extended (src/app/design/constants.ts, src/app/design/tabs/DomainTab.tsx; both-sides additions), was resolved by keeping both sides with a python script, and `cherry-pick --continue` at 05:38:36 also folded in a type move (PrioritiesPageProps -> src/types/priorities.ts as PrioritiesPageData) plus lint/typecheck/knip (result 05:39:14). `commits` counts `git commit` commands (1 main docs commit + 3 subagent commits); the branch itself carries 4 commits (3 cherry-picked + docs, head d6b5ce3). The single push rode on the docs-commit command at 06:04:40 (`git push -u origin claude/page-structure-b3`).

Tool errors: 9. Five are the worktree isolation guard refusing subagent Bash commands as 'too complex to verify that it stays inside the worktree' (Dump x3, Board x1, Priorities x1: heredoc file writes, python edit scripts, a `cd src && for ...` loop); the agents then used the Write tool (9 Write calls, all in subagents) or simpler commands. The main session's four: Playwright's chromium executable missing for its own click-through script (05:42:00, fixed by pointing at the installed browser), `ls` exit 2 for a missing PR template and a missing .claude/skills (expected), and `pkill -f "next dev"` exit 144 at the end. No retries of the same failing command beyond those fixes.

Stop hook: one 'Stop hook feedback' turn at 05:32:55 (untracked files; they were the subagents' worktrees under .claude/worktrees/). The session added that path to .git/info/exclude, said so, and ended turn 0 at 05:33:07 while the subagents were still running; no commit or push was made in response.

Browser check: ui-verifier returned VERDICT: FAIL on 1 of 10 tab/width pairs (the desktop-only 'Board - backlog open' tab at 390 px shows a play-step alert because two controls are named 'Open backlog'); the session judged it pre-existing and did not fix it, and says in the final summary that it did not reproduce it on main. Besides that delegated check, the main session spent about 22 minutes (05:40:53 -> 06:03:28, 17 Bash calls) writing and debugging its own Playwright click-through script in the scratchpad against a dev server it started (browser path, hidden duplicate elements, hydration timing, mobile selectors, a tracked-card expectation it verified against main) - its largest single time block, done in parallel with the ui-verifier.

Timing: setup ran in the background inside the first Bash call (`npm run setup &`) while the session read the spike, then a pgrep wait loop returned at 05:31:13 (5.3 min). Agents spawned 05:31:38-05:32:07 (26 s after setup end). npm test (50 files, 436 passed + 2 expected fail) took 10 s; e2e (26 passed) 76 s. From the task start to the push: 39.3 min; PR #90 opened at 06:05:27 via mcp__github__create_pull_request after a ToolSearch to load the GitHub tools; subscribe_pr_activity at 06:05:33. CI: first get_check_runs at 06:05:48 showed 2 of 8 complete; the session ended turn 4 ('I'll wait for the result events'), was woken by the check_suite.completed webhook (queued 06:08:11Z, read 06:08:15), and the get_check_runs at 06:08:19 showed all 8 check runs success (ci_green_confirmed 06:08:20.7); ~2.3 min idle between turns 4 and 5. No check-in (send_later) was scheduled, as the task asked.

No questions were asked to nobody: the session never asked for input; its judgment calls (cherry-pick workflow, type-file unification, FALLBACK_QUADRANT move, archiving the spike in this PR, the un-fixed ui-verifier FAIL) are listed in the final summary and the PR description. The session wrote its user-facing status lines and final summary in Chinese; the task prompt was in English. The docs commit also archived the spike (design/spike/archived/component-structure.md) and rewrote tracker/baseline/AGENTS.md/README entries. The transcript ends with the final summary at 06:08:51; the PR subscription stays open.
